title: React Testing Library
description: Test React components by interacting with them like a user.

data.text: React Testing Library is a set of helpers for testing React components. It encourages testing from the user's perspective by querying the DOM the way a user would, rather than relying on implementation details.

data.title: Basic Component Test
data.content: Render and interact with a component.

terms.definition: Renders a React component into the test DOM.
A collection of queries for finding elements in the document.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Test components from the user's perspective
Queries reflect how users find elements
Avoids brittle tests tied to implementation
data.takeaway: React Testing Library helps you write maintainable, user-focused tests.
